paired_unit: mean of per-seed metrics within each window and WT repeat; then optional mean of the two repeats at each position
boundary_unit: global original proxy and exploratory distance-restricted proxy are distinct; neither is expert-validated biological boundary error
ssim_distance_rule: Assign the unchanged 7x7 SSIM map by center-pixel genomic distance; require the original full valid neighborhood, not a zeroed distance-band image.
band_boundary_rule: Exploratory distance-restricted profile: keep the original flank=8, radius=5 and 200 bp resolution; require at least half of the geometrically possible pairs within that band. No pairs means not_evaluable, never zero. Do not replace the original whole-profile boundary metric.

example.source: frozen 100 bp contact counts plus saved valid target mask; no raw scan

limitations: Exploratory reanalysis of repeatedly viewed WT data, not a new external validation.
53 positions in 7 spatial groups; repeated measurements/seeds are not independent biological samples.
Far-distance boundary proxy is NA because the fixed 8x8 profile has no such pairs.
Near-band SSIM is NA because no original full valid 7x7 neighborhood lies at these center distances.
SSIM bands assign map centers; the unchanged 7x7 neighborhood may cross band boundaries.
Synthetic degradation and noisy measured targets; no claim about true low-depth Hi-C to Micro-C recovery.
